author: AtditC
body:
4lextr was breaking the rules with damaging and killing people inside the redstone lines on Quintus. A vide can be found on here: http://www.atdit.ch/4lextr/

I didn't upload it to YouTube because it takes a while to render it to 1080p and the fps are somehow bad.

Before punishing him, take a look at his infractions, many Combat Logging infraction and scams there....

Greetings,
Atdit
